messages:
emma_cs: quick alert 0:15 UTC1 - a small set of EU private-deploy customers are seeing onboarding items stuck in 'processing' for >1h. opening thread to coordinate comms and credits. affected: LumenAI (tenant-8812), MediLink (tenant-9921).

ryan_eng: looking. initial signal is high requeue rates on the ingestion worker plus a failed cache invalidation after a config migration. some workers were blocked by a file lock on the index shard.

olivia_pm: timeline please & any immediate mitigations we can tell customers?

ryan_eng: mitigation in progress: (1) release hotfix to avoid shard lock, (2) kick off controlled replays at lower concurrency, (3) bump processing workers in EU cluster. hotfix deploy in ~8m.

harry_support: customers pinging support asking ETA. need a one-paragraph status for email now. also what comp policy applies?

emma_cs: short status ok: "We're processing a backlog caused by a deployment migration; engineers have deployed a hotfix and reprocessing is underway; expected catch-up within 60-90 minutes. We'll update when your queue is cleared." Offer: pro-rated credit for affected time + optional 1-hr enablement session for enterprise accounts.

priya_csm: will queue CSM outreach. please include instructions to escalate if any activation items fail after replay. i'll prep an FAQ for our CSMs.

infra_bot: Deploy 1859999998 started by ryan_eng - hotfix: avoid-shard-lock v1.2.

ryan_eng: hotfix live, started low-concurrency replays for tenant-8812 & tenant-9921. LumenAI throughput back to normal; MediLink at ~60% processed. monitoring errors and queue length.

emma_cs: draft customer note below - please trim if needed.

emma_cs: ```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced a short backlog while processing onboarding items earlier today in our EU private deployment region. Our engineers identified a shard lock caused by a config migration and deployed a hotfix. Reprocessing is underway; most accounts will be fully caught up within 60-90 minutes.

What we did: deployed a hotfix to remove shard locks, restarted processing workers, and started a controlled replay of your activation queue.
What to expect: if you see continued failed activations after 90 minutes, reply to this email and we'll prioritize a callback.
Compensation: we'll apply a pro-rated service credit for the affected time. Enterprise customers can request a complimentary 1-hour enablement session to review onboarding best practices.

We value your patience and feedback. If you'd like to share any notes about the activation experience, reply and we'll capture it for our product team.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

harry_support: sending to LumenAI now. holding MediLink until we confirm full catch-up.

ryan_eng: MediLink fully processed at 1859999999, no residual errors. posting postmortem draft shortly with deploy diff, metrics (requeue-rate, worker-count), and action items to prevent recurrence.

olivia_pm: please include a follow-up improvement: add a pre-migration checkpoint that verifies shard locks are clear; also add an alert on sustained requeue-rate > 5% for 10m.

priya_csm: capturing renewal-risk note for MediLink & LumenAI: both flagged low risk but we'll offer the enablement session to strengthen relationship. scheduling outreach tonight.

legalbot: credit policy confirmed for pro-rated credit. please attach incident tag 'eu-onboard-backlog-1859999997' to the customer record.

emma_cs: tagging incident and wrapping up this thread. thanks y'all 60a. will publish customer-facing RCA later with more details and timeline. reopen if any regressions.

infra_bot: Incident eu-onboard-backlog-1859999997 created by emma_cs."
